subject.title: feat(plugins): expose resolved agentId on plugin command context

question: Should OpenClaw accept resolver-backed ctx.agentId as a public PluginCommandContext field for plugin command authors?
rationale: This is additive and technically narrow, but it expands the public Plugin SDK command context and therefore needs maintainer confirmation of the long-term API contract.

options.title: Accept and document ctx.agentId
options.body: Treat ctx.agentId as the optional host-resolved command agent field, add a short command-author docs note, and merge after the branch is refreshed and checks stay green.

options.title: Decline the context expansion
options.body: Close this PR and keep command authors on existing sessionKey/runtime APIs until a different plugin session identity contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept and document ctx.agentId
recommendation.body: Treat ctx.agentId as the optional host-resolved command agent field, add a short command-author docs note, and merge after the branch is refreshed and checks stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: huntharo authored the merged plugin-surface expansion this PR builds on, making them the best routing candidate among the history signals for API-shape intent.
